met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over South Chhattisgarh & neighbourhood persisted over the same region at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 12th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is likely to move west-northwestwards across south Chhattisgarh & Vidarbha during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jaisalmer, Rajgarh, Betul, centre of Low Pressure Area over south Chhattisgarh & neighbourhood, Gopalpur and thence east southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough from South Interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across Tamil Nadu persists and now extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Konkan adjoining Eastcentral Arabian sea between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level titling southwestwards with height persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & adjoining Jammu between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft in middle tropospheric westerlies level with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 70°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over central Assam & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
